title: Copilot Studio: improvements to the agent evaluations experience
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, evaluation limits and six control surfaces are supported. The cost guidance should mention that an agent's monthly limit does not stop its agent flows, and the prediction about additional source material in results should be framed as a possibility rather than a documented outcome.

claims.claim: Blocking the same Microsoft Copilot Studio connector also prevents event triggers.
claims.quote: To prevent agent makers from adding event triggers to their agents ... configure a data policy that blocks the **Microsoft Copilot Studio** connector.

claims.claim: The connector data policy governs agents in environments within its scope.
claims.quote: These data policies apply to Copilot Studio agents in the environments included in the policy's scope.

claims.claim: Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant > Save reaches the environment's tenant-capacity setting.
claims.quote: select **Licensing** ... Under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio** ... **Manage Copilot Credits** ... Select the environment ... Under **Capacity overages**, clear **Draw from the available capacity in my tenant** ... **Save**.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the environment allocation using scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements with MCSMessages, allocation.quantity and TenantPool enforcementRules enabled=false.
claims.quote: scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId } ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 } ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion

claims.claim: Turning off tenant-capacity draw does not prevent continued usage through an environment's pay-as-you-go plan.
claims.quote: If the environment is linked to a pay-as-you-go billing plan, usage can continue through the linked Azure subscription.

claims.claim: Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit > Stop usage > Save reaches the agent monthly limit's stopping option.
claims.quote: go to **Licensing** > **Copilot Studio** ... **Manage Agents** ... Select the agent, and then select **Set limit** ... Turn on **Stop usage** ... Select **Save**.

claims.claim: The version 2024-10-01 PUT licensing/environments/<environment-id>/entitlements/<entitlement-id>/resources/<resource-id>/threshold endpoint sets an environment-resource threshold using limit and stopIfOverCapacity=true.
claims.quote: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/entitlements/{entitlementId}/resources/{resourceId}/threshold?api-version=2024-10-01 ... stopIfOverCapacity ... Indicates whether to stop consuming the capacity if the resource exceeds its limit.

claims.claim: The threshold reference gives no agent-specific resource-ID mapping example.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "resource threshold" "resourceId" "agent". Read Upsert Resource Threshold in full: resourceId is described as the resource ID, with no agent-specific mapping example.

claims.claim: Share in the agent's Copilot Studio menu is the entry point for assigning Agent viewer.
claims.quote: Open the agent and select the three dots (**...**) > **Share** ... Under **Has permissions for this agent as**, select **Agent viewer** from the role list.
claims.fix: Expand the parenthesis to 'Copilot Studio > agent > Share > user or group > Has permissions for this agent as > Agent viewer'. The existing prose reaches the sharing page but leaves the role-selection steps to the linked documentation.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit is not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Caps; Governance controls
claims.claim: The capacity and consumption controls described under the Microsoft Copilot harness apply across Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: Allocation management requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent licensing-and-capacity management role.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the **Power Platform Administrator** or **Global Administrator** role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: A published environment-group tenant-capacity-draw rule makes the environment-level setting read-only.
claims.quote: When you publish a rule, it governs every environment in the group. The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: API updates attempting to override the published group rule are rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the `TenantPoolLockedByPolicy` error.

claims.claim: The group rule can be changed and republished rather than overridden at environment level.
claims.quote: Change and republish the rule for the environment group

claims.claim: Removing an environment from the group permits independent management of the setting.
claims.quote: remove the environment from the group to manage the setting independently. After removal, the environment retains the value last applied by the group, but the setting becomes editable.

claims.claim: Turning off the Microsoft Copilot Studio connection prevents authenticated tests in the evaluation tool.
claims.quote: Agent evaluations that use user authentication require access through the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector. If your admin turns off this connection, you can't run tests by using the evaluation tool.

claims.claim: A variable cost rating reflects the documented Copilot Credit meter.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use consumption-based billing. Building, testing, evaluating, and running these agents can consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: No dedicated evaluation control beyond the authenticated-run connector restriction was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluations administrator enable disable evaluations switch Power Platform admin center settings. Read the data-policy and evaluation pages; searched settings-features for evaluation. No additional evaluation-specific availability control found.
